decision: Retain the DOS 6.0-identical Windows DOS patch signature data included in the kernel data segment.
evidence: The source matches DOS 6.0 and astro byte for byte.
DOS MSDATA includes the file directly.

After assembling current MSDATA in an isolated stage, 134 bytes explicitly extracted from the listing in DOSDATA offsets 12CFh–1361h match target MSDOS.SYS at inferred DOSDATA file base 8190h; 13 wrapped bytes were not parsed by this check.
Review 086 compares the larger DOSDATA range and reports no differing byte in this patch-data range.
A targeted lexical search found no NT/BOP markers.
limitations: DOSDATA base is inferred from prior module layout. This comparison does not establish Windows patch runtime semantics or final linked kernel identity.
